sources.title: Public Rights of Way & Common Land
sources.verified_claim: The Planning Inspectorate collection separates common-land and public-rights-of-way casework and guidance; collection coverage does not establish a route or common-land status at a sample parcel.

sources.title: Rights of way order information: Decisions and maps published in 2026
sources.verified_claim: The 2026 register publishes order decisions and maps for specific authorities and routes. A national decision list is not evidence that any sample parcel intersects a public right of way.

sources.title: Common land: guidance for commons registration authorities and applicants
sources.publisher: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs / Natural England
sources.verified_claim: Commons registration authorities maintain and correct registers and process applications; register status must be checked against the exact land.

sources.title: Commons registrations authorities: applications and proposals
sources.publisher: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs
sources.verified_claim: The guidance covers applications and proposals that can amend common-land and village-green registers, so register entries can be subject to formal change processes.

sources.title: Application form to deregister common land or village greens
sources.verified_claim: Section 16 applications can deregister or exchange common land or greens subject to statutory requirements; the existence of this process does not imply candidate land is registered common.

sources.title: Commons registers: how to apply to make changes
sources.publisher: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs / Natural England
sources.verified_claim: The guidance explains how registered common land and village-green records may be changed, referred, heard and decided; exact candidate status requires the relevant register entry.

sources.title: Common land and village greens
sources.verified_claim: Common-land and village-green registers record land descriptions, rights and ownership information, but users are directed to the local council register for location-specific status.

sources.title: Commons registration authorities: maintain registers of commons and greens
sources.publisher: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs / Natural England
sources.verified_claim: London boroughs are commons registration authorities; the guidance also notes registers are not always accurate and may need correction, preserving a fail-closed exact-match requirement.
